title: Von Braun tells Edgar Mitchell of his knowledge

tellings.quote: Edgar Mitchell says that he, you know, comes to him and says, you know, he has knowledge of this stuff

plain: According to the Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell, the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun once came to him and said he had knowledge of UFOs. Michels passes this on as something Mitchell said, in a 2025 episode with Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer. If true, one of the leading figures of the American space programme would have privately claimed inside knowledge of the subject.
